meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把产品/营销链接、粘贴的脚本或简报，逐步做成发布/推广视频：先捕获素材、定设计，再写分镜和脚本，最后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户提出产品发布、推广、展示等营销需求，或提供商业链接、要求网站导览时触发；意图不明转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 按这个产品链接做一条发布视频：https://example.com
say.note: 会先确认技能更新，再捕获该页面素材。

say.text: 这是我写的产品脚本，请做成推广视频。
say.note: 会按简报决定逐字或重构叙述。

say.text: 给我的网站做一个展示视频。
say.note: 会使用真实截图，不重做网页。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: it captures assets, sets a design system, writes a storyboard and script, then renders a video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to publish, promote, or showcase a product, gives a commercial URL, or asks for a site tour; unclear intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a launch video from this product link: https://example.com
say_en.note: Confirms the skill update first, then captures the page.

say_en.text: Here is my product script; turn it into a promo video.
say_en.note: Narration is verbatim or restructured per the brief.

say_en.text: Make a showcase video for my website.
say_en.note: Uses real screenshots instead of rebuilding the site.
